description: Verify that DUT accepts an ACK piggybacked on the next transmit packet and replies with a pure ACK acknowledging the payload (RFC 793 §3.9 Event Processing)
approach:
[Objective]
A TCP receiver must process payload bytes whether they ride alone or piggyback on an outgoing-direction segment. RFC 793 §3.9 dictates the ack_num covers the received bytes either way.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: 3-way handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: data segment with ACK bit set + payload.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: pure ACK with ack_num = received data end (= recv_isn + 1 + payload_len)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT emits a pure ACK whose ack_num covers the piggybacked payload.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_no_data_ack — no DUT ACK to the piggyback data
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ACK value does not cover the payload

verdicts.Pass: DUT acknowledged the piggyback payload with a pure ACK — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_data_ack: No DUT ACK to piggyback data
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT ack_num does not acknowledge piggyback payload
